LESSON: DAINIK PRARTHANA (DAILY PRAYERS)

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: General
Strand: Worship
Topic 4.1: Dainik Prarthana (Daily prayers)

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Dainik Prarthana (Daily prayers). Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in Dainik Prarthana (Daily prayers)
2. Practise Dainik Prarthana (Daily prayers) at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Dainik Prarthana (Daily prayers)

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Explain the main ideas in Dainik Prarthana (Daily prayers)
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the main ideas in Dainik Prarthana (Daily prayers). Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. Practise Dainik Prarthana (Daily prayers) at school and at home
   In simple words: practise until you can practise Dainik Prarthana (Daily prayers) at school and at home. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Dainik Prarthana (Daily prayers)
   In simple words: practise until you can give Kenyan examples connected to Dainik Prarthana (Daily prayers). Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Dainik Prarthana (Daily prayers) using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Dainik Prarthana (Daily prayers) in the examples.
2. Explain Dainik Prarthana (Daily prayers) to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Dainik Prarthana (Daily prayers).
4. Practise one skill from this lesson with a friend.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Dainik Prarthana (Daily prayers) using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Dainik Prarthana (Daily prayers) important for a Grade 4 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Explain the main ideas in Dainik Prarthana (Daily prayers)
2. Practise Dainik Prarthana (Daily prayers) at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Dainik Prarthana (Daily prayers)

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
